edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient and key owner checked and burned in mintWithTreasureKey.
msg.sender is the mint recipient for public multi-token mint.
msg.sender is used for the team whitelist check and mint recipient.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random entropy of randomIndex.
block.timestamp is used as randomness entropy, making the outcome miner-influenceable (weak randomness/timestamp dependency).
mintWithTreasureKey performs an external key-burn call before the state-changing mint completes.
The external treasure keys contract could re-enter mintWithTreasureKey during burnKeyForAddress.
After burning the key the flow continues into _mintWithRandomTokenId.
mintWithTreasureKey calls _mintWithRandomTokenId for the caller.
_mintWithRandomTokenId obtains the token id from randomIndex.
_mintWithRandomTokenId mints via ERC721 _safeMint.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on a contract recipient before mint state is fully settled.
A malicious recipient contract can re-enter via onERC721Received during safe mint.
randomIndex reads and increments the nonce seed.
randomIndex reads and writes the shuffled indices array.
randomIndex uses TOKEN_LIMIT to compute the remaining supply.
totalSize modulo bounds the computed index in randomIndex.
selected shuffled index determines the value returned by randomIndex.
randomIndex result becomes the minted token id in _mintWithRandomTokenId.
mintPublicMultipleTokens consumes the caller-supplied _amount parameter.
mintTeamMultipleTokens consumes the caller-supplied _amount parameter.
The public mint loop invokes _mintWithRandomTokenId _amount times.
The team mint loop invokes _mintWithRandomTokenId _amount times.
Public mint validates _amount against _maxTokensAtOnce.
Public mint requires publicSale to be active.
Public mint compares msg.value against _tokenPrice multiplied by _amount.
Public mint caps supply against TOKEN_LIMIT minus TREASURE_KEYS_LIMIT.
Team mint requires teamSale to be active.
Team mint checks the caller against the _teamSaleAddresses whitelist.
Team mint caps supply against TOKEN_LIMIT minus TREASURE_KEYS_LIMIT.
setTokenPrice writes the _tokenPrice state variable.
The owner-supplied _price parameter is stored by setTokenPrice.
setTreasureKeys writes the external keys contract address.
enablePublicSale sets publicSale to true.
enablePublicSale resets _maxTokensAtOnce to 20.
disablePublicSale sets publicSale to false.
disablePublicSale sets _maxTokensAtOnce to 1.
getTokenPrice reads the _tokenPrice state variable.
togglePaused controls the Pausable state affecting guarded functions.
release reads the payable account parameter as the payee.
The payee account determines the computed payment in release.
Released balances and total released feed the payment computation.
release performs an external value transfer after state updates but still exposes the value call.
The payee contract can re-enter release during the low-level value call.
_baseURI supplies the metadata base used when tokens are created and queried.
_tokenID local is the derived id passed to _safeMint.
randomIndex value is assigned to the _tokenID local before minting.

Non-core caller amount parameter is only meaningful within the team mint function and is normalized into it.
Transient computation local inside randomIndex, merged into its containing function.
Transient pseudo-random index local within randomIndex, merged into its containing function.
Transient shuffled value local within randomIndex, merged into its containing function.
Transient computed payout local within PaymentSplitter.release, merged into that function.
Non-core payee parameter is used only by release and is normalized into it.
Owner-supplied price parameter is used only by setTokenPrice and is normalized into it.
Transient token id local used only during the random mint helper, merged into it.
